frames.narration: A request arrives at the gateway. The gateway creates a correlation id, req-8f3a, and will pass it on to every service it calls.
The gateway logs an event with named fields, one of them the id: { event: request_received, request_id: req-8f3a, user_id: 42 }.
It calls the payment service and sends the id along in a header. The payment service puts the same id on every line it writes.
The payment fails. It logs { level: error, event: payment_failed, reason: card_declined, request_id: req-8f3a }. Sensitive fields such as the card number are left out.
The pipeline parses each record and ships it to the log store, which indexes every field.

Support searches request_id = req-8f3a. They get exactly the lines from both services, in order, and nothing else. Free text would have needed guessing at wording and matching on a number that appears in many lines.
The same fields answer other questions without grep: how many payment_failed events per hour, for which reason, for which user.
